title: site.yaml
description: Settings for the whole website, shared by every government on it: the site's name, how to contact it, which governments appear and in what order, and the property-tax estimate page.

title.description: The site's name, shown in the header and the browser tab.

contact_email.description: The public email address readers can write to. Never a personal address.

repository.description: Web address of the project's public code repository, linked from the About page.

default_government.description: The government the site opens on when a reader visits the home address. Must be one of the ids listed under governments.

governments.description: The governments on the site, in the order the City / County / School switch lists them. Each id is a folder under governments/. Only governments with data appear in the switch; with one government there is no switch.

items.description: A government id (its folder name under governments/).

tax_estimate.description: The property-tax estimate page: which years it compares and where readers look up their assessed value. Leave it out and the page is not built.

rates.description: Where the website finds the tax rates file, relative to the web folder.

this_year.description: The tax year the page treats as "this year".

next_year.description: The tax year the page treats as "next year" (the newest budget's year).

reassessment_year.description: The first tax year that uses new assessed values after a countywide reassessment. Rates before and after it apply to different values, so the page pairs each rate with the value from the same year.

lookup.description: Outside websites where a reader can look up their assessed value, one per assessment year.

assessed_year.description: The assessment year this lookup site shows values for.

name.description: The lookup site's name as the page shows it.

search.description: The lookup site's search address. The page sends the reader there; it never fetches values itself.

reassessment_source.description: A public document that explains the reassessment, linked from the page.
